summary: Iteration 46 - Portal Switcher Feature Testing Complete. All 8 test scenarios passed. Admin users can switch between GymFix AI Dashboard (/dashboard) and Pulse Fitness Portal (/pulse) via user dropdown. Admin banner displays correctly on Pulse portal. Regular lite users do NOT see admin features.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portal switcher feature fully working. Admin users (account_type='full' or is_master_admin=true) can switch between /dashboard and /pulse. Key test IDs: nav-portal-switch-btn (in Navbar dropdown), admin-pulse-banner (blue banner on Pulse), admin-back-to-gymfix (link in banner), pulse-switch-to-gymfix (in Pulse user dropdown). Lite users see only 5 tabs (Dashboard, Equipment, Log a Fault, Documents, Upgrade to Pro) and no admin features.

1_admin_portal_switch_button.notes: User dropdown on /dashboard shows 'Switch to Pulse Portal' button (data-testid='nav-portal-switch-btn') for admin users

2_switch_to_pulse_navigation.notes: Clicking 'Switch to Pulse Portal' navigates to /pulse and loads Pulse Fitness dashboard

3_admin_banner_on_pulse.notes: Blue banner at top shows 'Viewing Pulse Fitness Portal as Admin' with 'Back to GymFix AI' link (data-testid='admin-pulse-banner')

4_back_to_gymfix_link.notes: Clicking 'Back to GymFix AI' link (data-testid='admin-back-to-gymfix') navigates back to /dashboard

5_admin_pro_tabs_on_pulse.notes: Admin sees all 7 tabs on Pulse: Dashboard, Equipment, Log a Fault, Documents, Check Sheets, Reports, AI Diagnosis. isPro=true for admin.

6_pulse_dropdown_switch_option.notes: Pulse user dropdown for admin shows 'Switch to GymFix AI' option (data-testid='pulse-switch-to-gymfix')

7_pulse_dropdown_switch_navigation.notes: Clicking 'Switch to GymFix AI' in Pulse dropdown navigates back to /dashboard

8_lite_user_no_admin_features.notes: Regular lite user (test@gymfixai.com) does NOT see: admin banner, Pro tabs (only 5 tabs + Upgrade), or 'Switch to GymFix AI' option in dropdown

admin-pulse-banner - Admin banner at top of Pulse portal
admin-back-to-gymfix - 'Back to GymFix AI' link in admin banner
pulse-switch-to-gymfix - 'Switch to GymFix AI' option in Pulse user dropdown
lite-user-menu - User menu button on Pulse portal
